title: Instalment loan
seo_title: Apply for a loan | loans by mal
seo_description: Apply for a loan with loans by mal. Complete our simple online application form. Repayment periods of 12, 18 or 24 months available.
html:
Affordable loans

You can choose to make your repayments over a period up to 36 months, to suit your circumstances.

Example

Taking a loan of £2,000 on an instalment repayment plan to be repaid over a 12 month period.

You receive funds into your bank account and will start the repayments on the agreed date.

How much can I borrow?

We base the amount you can borrow on your monthly income, plus any other regular monthly income, with a minimum loan of £1,000 up to a maximum loan of £5,000.

Apply now

Important Note

Late repayments can lead to serious money problems. For debt counselling advice please visit moneyadviceservice.org.uk

Apply Today

It's as easy as 1-2-3 to get your loan

If you wish to proceed with taking out a loan, please click on ‘Start your application’ button below. You will be asked your loan amount, repayment term, as well as providing some personal details.

Using the details you have supplied, we will run checks to see if we can accept your loan application.

Once you have signed your application and verified your online banking, we will be in touch for a quick 5-10 minute call to discuss monthly repayments.

Borrow from loans by MAL

We make loan decisions on affordability and creditworthiness

Our loans have a maximum 36 month term

Before you sign the agreement you will always know what you will repay and the terms

Loan FAQs

For our full list of FAQs, please click here

An unsecured loan is not secured on any asset. It does not require a guarantor. Your loan will be confidential in so far that you don’t have to discuss it with anyone, other than us to make an application to borrow from loans by mal.

We base the amount you can borrow on your monthly income, with a minimum loan of £1,000 up to a maximum loan of £5,000. We can lend up to 2x your income. This can include your salary, self employed income and your pension.

No. Your repayments are fixed throughout the term of the loan. This gives you the security of knowing at the outset what you are paying each month.
